verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes provides a programmatic SDK (Python/JS/Go) to create sandboxes, execute commands, read output/logs, and terminate them, explicitly marketed for autonomous agents running untrusted code; the agent.md example demonstrates an LLM agent generating and executing code inside a Sandbox end-to-end, and community builders (MCP-JS, self-hosted runners) corroborate real agent-driven provisioning/teardown. Missing for 10: independent third-party audit of full lifecycle automation without any human-in-the-loop step, and more detail on automated teardown/cleanup semantics.
